verdict.rationale: Heap's pricing page lists "Report alerts" as a feature of a paid tier, so some first-party alerting on reports exists. Nothing describes how those alerts trigger, whether they detect abnormal metric movement, or whether users can subscribe to dashboards. missing for 10: dashboard subscription/scheduled delivery, anomaly-based (abnormal movement) alert detection, documentation of alert configuration and delivery channels, independent or hands-on corroboration.
